correctness.rationale: A nonzero square-zero 2x2 matrix has rank one with image=kernel, hence M=t[[-uv,u^2],[-v^2,uv]] for exactly one primitive projective line and nonzero integer t. Coprimality identifies gcd of all entries as |t| and norm as |t|max(u,|v|)^2. The primitive sector count L_I(x)=(12/pi^2)mu(I)x^2+O_I(x log(2x)) follows by polygonal lattice counting and Mobius inversion. Summing 2*L_I(sqrt(qT/t)) over positive t<=T^alpha yields alpha*q*mu(I) times (24/pi^2)Tlog T with the claimed errors; total count is 8*sum phi(m)floor(T/m^2). The alpha=1 probability follows from squeezing alpha upward, not a uniform endpoint bound; infinite direction has O(T) mass. The supplied verifier was read rather than trusted as a proof. Independently enumerated square-zero matrices and content distributions at T=2,5,10,20 (16 comparisons; 248 matrices at T=20).

Content, matrix height and kernel direction are genuinely different geometric/arithmetic observables; a total count does not determine their joint dependence.
